{{Quote|Is this the tongue you are more speaking like, yes?"<br />"We understand you."<br />"Good! Then I am ''G'hinji'', and I am repeating what I say, yes? I say&mdash;'Don't hurt me, I'm old!' Yes?|G'hinji Dros and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel62" />}}
'''G'hinji Dros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] who served as Eldest of the [[Argwin]] caste on [[Shalyvane]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A resident of the city of [[Chinshassa]], Dros survived the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] destruction of his home in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], surviving with many others of his people in a nomadic existence among the ruins. As an esteemed elder, Dros was the one to meet with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] when they visited Chinshassa in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], investigating the background of Imperial double agent [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|In matter of truth, until three cycles ago, city was being lived in by my own people! Yes! Was great majesty, and wonderful comfort. But then, one day&mdash;city die!|G'hinji Dros|<ref name="marvel62" />}}
[[File:GhinjiLukeChewie.jpg|thumb|left|200px|G'hinji Dros with Luke Skywalker and Chewbacca.]]
An [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] native of the city of [[Chinshassa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalyvane]], G'hinji Dros found himself embroiled in intrigues between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="marvel62" /> Already quite old by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dros held the title of Eldest of the [[Argwin]] caste.<ref name="G1" /> Dros lived in a modern, prosperous city until Chinshassa was suddenly destroyed by Imperial forces in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]&mdash;the act was done merely to provide cover for an Imperial agent named [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], who posed as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor of Em'liy aggression as she infiltrated the Rebels as a deep-cover agent with the task of either [[Death/Legends|killing]] or ruining Rebel hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. From that point on, Dros and his clan lived as nomads, subsisting in the ruins of their former home. Brie ultimately achieved her goal during [[Operation Earplug]], when Skywalker mistakenly shot her down in what appeared to be a friendly-fire incident, resulting in Skywalker becoming a pariah. At a loss to explain why [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] had guided him to attack Brie, Skywalker traveled to Chinshassa to investigate Brie's background.<ref name="marvel62" />

It was there Dros met both Skywalker and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion&mdash;as the Em'liy spoke passable [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Dros was assigned to test the visitors in a traditional Em'liy "trial by ordeal" before deciding whether or not they would be allowed to live&mdash;upon their arrival, a horde of Em'liy warriors charged and herded Skywalker and Chewbacca into a ruined building Dros was hiding in, where he established contact. Skywalker impressed Dros by using the Force to find a novel solution to the trial by ordeal, convincing the Em'liy to introduce the Rebels to the rest of his people and grant Skywalker's request to travel to the [[Circle of Kavaan/Legends|Circle of Kavaan]], an Em'liy holy site that Skywalker had previously witnessed Brie perform a strange ritual at.<ref name="marvel62" /> At the Circle, Skywalker uncovered a hidden [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] revealing Brie's status as an Imperial agent, prompting the Rebels to go off on a wider investigation.<ref name="marvel63">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ha! You got some pretty strong gods there! Ha!|G'hinji Dros, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel62" />}}
A good-natured Em'liy with a strong sense of humor, G'hinji Dros was already elderly by the era of the Galactic Civil War, but spoke good enough Basic that he became the ideal choice to be the Em'liy's emissary to their Rebel visitors. Dros was a pious believer in the Em'liy gods, but was impressed by Luke Skywalker's use of the Force&mdash;to Dros, it simply meant that Skywalker had strong gods of his own.<ref name="marvel62" />

==Behind the scenes==
G'hinji Dros first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 62|''Star Wars'' (1977) 62]], written by [[David Michelinie]] and released in [[1982]]. Originally just named "G'hinji,"<ref name="marvel62" /> the character's last name was later given in a ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' [[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series|article]] written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Joseph Bongiorno]] in [[2000]].<ref name="G1" /> During his comic appearances, Dros was illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]]<ref name="marvel62" /> and [[Tom Palmer]].<ref name="marvel63" />
